images.filename: Zalmay Khalilzad and Ashraf Ghani at Kabul University in 2005.jpg
images.caption: On Saturday, February 12, Ambassador and Special Presidential Envoy Zalmay Khalilzad and Chancellor of Kabul University Dr. Ghani opened the U.S. sponsored American Corner at Kabul University. Ambassador Khalilzad also announced the establishment of an English language-training program for Kabul University.

images.filename: Professor Azim Noorbakhsh, Lecturer for the Faculty of Journalism at Kabul University (111201-N-TH437-002).jpg
images.caption: Professor Azim Noorbakhsh, Lecturer for the Faculty of Journalism at Kabul University, and one of the course instructors, gives a graduation speech at the Ministry of Defense Media Center, in Kabul, Dec. 1. The five-week course covered Communications, Public Relations, Photojournalism, Video Journalism, Writing, Press Conferences and Press Releases. (U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 3rd Class Eric Lockwood)
images.alt: Professor Azim Noorbakhsh, Lecturer for the Faculty of Journalism at Kabul University, and one of the course instructors, gives a graduation speech at the Ministry of Defense Media Center, in Kabul, Dec. 1.
